content: Jin moved with zero wasted momentum. His knotted oak branch intercepted the lead thug's mace at a forty-five-degree angle, redirecting the four-hundred-pound force downward into the enforcer's knee. With a twist of his hips, Jin pivoted on his left ball, delivering a horizontal strike that fractured the second enforcer's collarbone.
critique: Sanderson/Gosu: Flawless mechanical redirection, kinetic bio-leverage.

content: Jin was a shadow dancing through rain. The branch in his hands became an extension of the mountain's ancient wrath, striking with the weight of granite and the fluid mercy of a winter torrent. In three breaths, seven men lay broken.
critique: Rothfuss/Inoue: Poetic martial dance, mythic grace.

content: Jin didn't just beat them; he beat them like dusty carpets on spring cleaning day. *Smack!* "Trespassing!" *Crack!* "Spitting on the steps!" *Crunch!* "Looking at me with those ugly pig eyes!" He swept three men off their feet with one low spin, kicked a fourth directly into the wagon wheel, and hopped on top of the guild master's chest with a wolf-grin.
critique: Biga/Studio LICO: Peak Chung Myung verbal abuse combined with devastating, merciless cudgel work.
